llm_response.reason: The site impersonates the Santoni brand by using its trademarks and displaying premium product images and discounts while using an unrelated domain. Key scam indicators include urgency tactics, ambiguous company information, psychological trust-building statements ('100% secure purchases'), lack of legit contact details, and mimicking the design of an authentic e-commerce site. There is no evidence this domain is affiliated with the legitimate Santoni company.
